mapper.select: SELECT supplier.* FROM oa_supplier supplier WHERE supplier.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND supplier.deleted = 0 AND supplier.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (supplier.cooperation_start_date IS NULL OR supplier.cooperation_start_date <= #{to}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oa_supplier_scorecard card WHERE card.tenant_id = supplier.tenant_id AND card.supplier_id = supplier.supplier_id AND card.deleted = 0 AND card.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND card.period_start <= #{from} AND card.period_end >= #{to}) ORDER BY supplier.supplier_id

SELECT DISTINCT employee.id, employee.tenant_id, employee.name, employee.user_id FROM hr_employee employee JOIN sys_user account ON account.user_id = employee.user_id AND account.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id WHERE employee.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND employee.deleted = 0 AND employee.employee_status NOT IN ('RESIGNED', 'TERMINATED') AND account.deleted = 0 AND account.status = '0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oa_project project WHERE project.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND project.deleted = 0 AND project.status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS') AND (project.start_date IS NULL OR project.start_date <= #{to}) AND (project.owner_id = employee.user_id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oa_project_member membership WHERE membership.tenant_id = project.tenant_id AND membership.project_id = project.project_id AND membership.user_id = employee.user_id AND membership.deleted = 0 AND (membership.join_date IS NULL OR membership.join_date <= #{to}) AND (membership.leave_date IS NULL OR membership.leave_date >= #{from})))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM oa_timesheet sheet JOIN oa_timesheet_detail detail ON detail.timesheet_id = sheet.timesheet_id AND detail.tenant_id = sheet.tenant_id WHERE sheet.tenant_id = employee.tenant_id AND sheet.employee_id = employee.id AND sheet.deleted = 0 AND detail.deleted = 0 AND sheet.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'APPROVING', 'APPROVED') AND detail.work_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}) ORDER BY employee.user_id
